Game Overview

In Glider, the core idea is straightforward: embark on an emotional journey, mastering the art of gliding through vast landscapes. Tilt or hover to soar gracefully, dodging obstacles and capturing stars to unlock cherished skin designs crafted by your late father. Your adventure awaits above the clouds!

How to Play

Glider keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge. Embark on an emotional journey, mastering the art of gliding through vast landscapes. Tilt or hover to soar gracefully, dodging obstacles and capturing stars to unlock cherished skin designs crafted by your late father. Your adventure awaits above the clouds!
